name: Uchiko (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Uchiko town emblem in light blue, green and orange: a light blue stylised device of vertical strokes with a green leaf and an orange disc.
history: Municipal flag of Uchiko, a town in Ehime Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 January 2005.

features.role: Uchiko town emblem — a light blue stylised device of vertical strokes with a green leaf and an orange disc
